Don't die down there, Echo. The world needs blobs like us.

The mole wants to destroy our home. Sonia is her name.
She digs the caverns bare, all for worthless pyrite.
If you are able, please stop her.
Hm? Who is there?
Dragon? Oh, welcome. I didn't recall you being so... large.
You defeated Sonia? Amazing! Though, I hardly think eating her was needed.
Hm? You gained weight for other reasons? Ah well.
If Sonia is gone, then I do hope that handsome wolf with the hammer takes charge.
He seems the most responsible. He understands the power of a proper curse.
Oh? Hello, little dragon.
I do wish we could meet under happier circumstances, but I am glad to meet regardless.
This cavern used to be an underground forest, but that horrid mole has been digging up our roots.
Were it not for her, we would be in a golden age!
...Hm? You are chasing the same mole as well? She stole your powers?
Well, if our interests align, perhaps I can lend you what energy I have left.
Our flowers grant flight to those who touch them.
Their powers are weakened, and your mass may also prove an issue, but they may still help.

Thank you, kind dragon.
My apologies again for missing the fight. I hadn't realized the others were there.
I'm glad I could've helped out in the end, at least.
And you must admit, my contribution was... how you say, "bad of ass?"
I did kind-of save the day at the last second with that one, you must admit.

Affamae
A one-armed monster obsessed with food. I get the feeling that, if I stick around, I will become their next meal...
Artifact of Echo

Wasp-Cannon
While they look more active than the Orbees,\nthey just shoot problems with honey until the Orbees do it for them.

Kara
